sleeping_bag.name: LITE LINE 200
sleeping_bag.subtitle: ultralight summer down sleeping bag
sleeping_bag.description: Lite Line 200 is presented as the lightest model in the ultralight Lite Line range, intended for warmer-part-of-the-year use, spring-summer mountain trips, forest bivy overnights and fast-and-light bikepacking.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 495 g total weight
- 200 g of 850 FP ethically sourced Polish goose down
- Comfort 9 C / limit 4 C
- Pertex Quantum 29 g/m2 shell and liner
- Full-length 5 mm YKK zip with 2 self-locking sliders
- Anti-snag system
- Down-filled zip insulating tube
- 3D shaped hood
- Anatomical shark-fin footbox
- H-shaped chamber design
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Cumulus presents Lite Line 200 as the go-to choice for light, reliable warm-weather sleeping with compact pack size and fast-and-light intent.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Warmer part of the year, spring-summer mountain trips, forest bivy overnights, fast-and-light bikepacking.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: France category price observed from user-provided capture is 289 EUR.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Lifetime Experience warranty shown on official pages.
sleeping_bag.current_status: current model listed on official category and official product pages
